Tencent just dropped something ridiculous

one image turns into a 3D world you can actually walk around in

not a video. an actual 3D asset. meshes and gaussian splats you can drop straight into Unity, Unreal or Blender.

that’s the whole point of it. Genie 3 and the other video world models give you a clip that looks great and then ends. this gives you a file that stays on your drive, renders in real time on a consumer GPU, and costs nothing to look at twice.

it also runs backwards. point it at a video you shot on your phone and WorldMirror 2.0 reconstructs the scene as 3D, predicting depth, normals, camera positions and point clouds in a single pass.

Haiku 5.5 dropped 2 days ago and it changes how you should be running Claude Code

keep Opus 5.5 as your main model, then hand the cheap work to Haiku subagents, reading code and looking up docs

Anthropic built it for exactly this, it’s around 75% cheaper than Haiku 4.5 and they name subagent work as the use case

one default will catch you out though, Claude Code’s built-in Explore subagent inherits your main model, so when Opus sends Explore to search your codebase, Explore runs on Opus too

make your own subagent called Explore with model: haiku and it replaces the built-in one
